arguments.code:
# Create the new playlist and add filtered R&B recommendations
pw=next(item for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if item['account_name']=='spotify')['password']
email='timothy.whit@gmail.com'
login_resp=apis.spotify.login(username=email,password=pw)
token=login_resp['access_token']

# target songs from previous computation
# Recompute quickly to avoid variable scope issues
from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); target_years={now.year, now.year-1}
all_recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    recs=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not isinstance(recs,list) or len(recs)==0:
        break
    all_recs.extend(recs)
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>50:
        break

filtered=[]
for r in all_recs:
    sid=r['song_id']
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre_norm=str(s.get('genre')).strip().lower() if s.get('genre') is not None else None
    release_date=s.get('release_date')
    rel_year=None
    if isinstance(release_date,str) and len(release_date)>=4:
        rel_year=int(release_date[:4])
    if genre_norm=='r&b' and rel_year in target_years:
        filtered.append(sid)

filtered_ids=sorted(list(set(filtered)))
print('target_count',len(filtered_ids))
print('target_song_ids',filtered_ids)

create=apis.spotify.create_playlist(title='Spotify R&B Recommendations',access_token=token,is_public=False)
print('create_playlist_resp',create)
playlist_id=create['playlist_id']

# Add songs
add_results=[]
for sid in filtered_ids:
    try:
        ar=apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id,song_id=int(sid),access_token=token)
        add_results.append((sid,'ok',ar))
    except Exception as e:
        add_results.append((sid,'fail',str(e)))

print('add_results_status',[(sid,st) for sid,st,_ in add_results])
print('add_ok_count',sum(1 for _,st,_ in add_results if st=='ok'))

# Verify by fetching playlist
pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id,access_token=token)
pl_song_ids=sorted([s['id'] if 'id' in s else s.get('song_id') for s in pl.get('songs',[])])
print('playlist_song_count',len(pl.get('songs',[])))
print('playlist_song_ids',pl_song_ids)
